{{Top|leg}}
The '''Starboard Shopping Arcade''' was located on the [[Bazaar Deck]] of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. It consisted of six shops and a secure storage area. Shops in the Starboard Shopping Arcade sold expensive jewellery and accessories, including [[surface tintware]].
